name: Frozen Influence
body:
School: evocation [cold]; Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Prop: Marotte

EFFECT

Range: Long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)

Target: One creature

Duration: 1 round

Saving Throw: Reflex half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target takes 1d8 points of cold damage +1 point per caster level. If the target fails a Reflex save, it is slowed (as the slow spell) until the end of your next turn. If you are wielding an orb, you may choose for the origin point of this spell to be the origin point for any spell you cast before the end of your next turn.
